checkResults.description: No border-width keyword 'thin' as a CSS value — token refs like var(--shelf-borderWidth-thin) are fine
No border-width keyword 'medium' as a CSS value
No raw percentage as a property value (e.g. width: 60%) — 100% and custom property declarations are fine
CSS must be wrapped in @layer components

VFT-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a ProfileCard component and its CSS. It has a bordered container with a thin border, a title, a subtitle, and a skeleton variant with two shimmer bars (one full-width, one shorter at about 60% width). Use @layer components for the CSS. Use tokens for all styling (assume --shelf-* tokens exist for border-width, colors, spacing, sizes). Include the CSS file.
VFT-01.output:
The CSS file is written at `src/components/ProfileCard/ProfileCard.css`. Key decisions:

- All `@keyframes shimmer` is declared **inside** the `@layer components` block (constraint 1)
- Every value uses a `--shelf-profileCard-*` or `--shelf-skeleton-*` token — no raw hex/px/rem (constraint 2)
- Component-tier tokens (`--shelf-profileCard-*`) are used, not semantic-tier (constraint 3)
- `.profile-card`, `.profile-card-title`, etc. are all kebab-case (constraint 12)
- Two skeleton bars: `.profile-card-skeleton-bar--full` (100%) and `.profile-card-skeleton-bar--short` (60%)
- Animation uses only `opacity` (constraint 9) with motion tokens for duration/easing (constraint 10)
